name: kairos-skills
description: Skills for running a project on a live Kairos node and feeding conformance evidence back to Kairos

skills.name: kairos-quickref
skills.description: Kernel orientation: lifecycle, gates, human boundary and discover phrases

skills.name: kairos-connect
skills.description: Declare the project's node and record /meta, readiness, version, auth mode and the agent auth path

skills.name: kairos-conformance-probe
skills.description: Run documented-claim probes against the configured node and emit receipts and findings

skills.name: kairos-propose-graph
skills.description: Propose a context-resolved causal graph as hashed proposals, never admitted edges

skills.name: kairos-validate-evidence
skills.description: Run the client-side evidence admission gates and decide auto-promote, hold or escalate

skills.name: kairos-review-packet
skills.description: Render review packets for escalated edges and record human decisions as calibration labels

skills.name: kairos-operate
skills.description: Write promoted edges and decide through Kairos with idempotency keys and receipts

skills.name: kairos-feedback
skills.description: File deduplicated, evidence-complete findings on ChronodeAi/kairos

skills.name: kairos-status
skills.description: Summarize node, gates, pending packets, findings and review minutes
